serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Our cloud-based platform enables organizations to build and deploy intelligent virtual assistants capable of:

- **Multi-Channel Engagement:** Natural language conversations across voice, chat, SMS, email, and digital channels.
- **Multilingual Support:** Advanced natural language processing for diverse constituent populations.
- **Analytics:** Comprehensive reporting on conversations, outcomes, and service levels.

The federal offering runs on dedicated federal infrastructure with a separate authorization boundary from the Entratus commercial platform.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Entratus Trust Portal containing FedRAMP Certification Data, security policies, and assessment materials for the Entratus Conversational AI Platform.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Federal agency personnel may request access by visiting https://trust.entratus.ai and submitting an access request with a government email address. Questions may be directed to the Security contact listed in this file.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Secure Configuration Guidance for agency administrators of the Entratus Conversational AI Platform, including recommended settings for identity, access, data retention, and channel integrations.
